tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Magnets And Magnetic Fields

questions.question: Foundation Name the four magnetic elements.
questions.correctAnswer: Q1: Iron, nickel, cobalt and steel (an alloy of iron).
questions.explanation: Answer: Q1: Iron, nickel, cobalt and steel (an alloy of iron).

questions.question: Foundation State the rule for what happens when two north poles are brought close together.
questions.correctAnswer: Q2: Like poles repel — two north poles will repel each other.
questions.explanation: Answer: Q2: Like poles repel — two north poles will repel each other.

questions.question: Foundation In which direction do magnetic field lines point?
questions.correctAnswer: Q4: Magnetic field lines point from north to south (outside the magnet).
questions.explanation: Answer: Q4: Magnetic field lines point from north to south (outside the magnet).
